## Week-2 change review

- [ ] This change is scoped to Document Intelligence and does not alter unrelated lab/legacy code.
- [ ] Retrieval, chunking, answerability, benchmark labels and frozen snapshot membership are unchanged unless explicitly justified.
- [ ] Service tests and relevant contract/security tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff and Mypy pass.
- [ ] Documentation and reproducibility metadata match the actual repository paths and measurements.
- [ ] No secrets, private PDFs, runtime volumes or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Any new limitation is documented honestly.
